design_philosophy.core_concept: Holistic Solopreneur Cockpit blending financial piloting, vision, growth, and wellbeing into a calm yet powerful executive hub.
anti_slop_principles: No generic purple tech gradients or plain flat cards.
Dual visual mood system: 'Mode Élan' (dynamic, actionable, crisp gold/emerald highlights) vs 'Mode Refuge' (soothing deep indigo, soft glows, grounding values/reflections).
Refined Glassmorphism with dark midnight blue backdrop blur, high contrast gold/green KPI indicators, and tight micro-interactions.
Distinctive typography: Serif display headings in 'Fraunces' paired with clean geometric body text in 'Poppins'.

testing.requirement: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, cards, navigation items, toggles, and modals MUST include a kebab-case `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use proper React imports (.js and .jsx files).
Implement smooth Framer Motion transitions when switching between Mode Élan and Mode Refuge.
Ensure theme toggles smoothly between Dark (Night Blue gradient) and Light mode.
Ensure Recharts components are styled with custom gold (#D4AF37) and emerald (#10B981) colors.
Verify all 11 modules listed in the problem statement are accessible via sidebar tabs or quick actions.
Verify mocked demo data is realistic, inspiring, and pre-populated for Sarah.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients if they conflict with contrast.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts (located in src/components/ui/sonner.jsx).
